Context: 4. Suspension and Subsistence Allowance

- GID (1), Rule 10 (1), Chapter 3.
4. A Disciplinary Authority may consider it appropriate to place a Government servant under suspension in the following circumstances. These are only intended for guidance and should not be taken as mandatory=-
- (i) Cases where continuance in office of the Government servant will prejudice the investigation, trial or any inquiry (e.g. appre hended tampering with witnesses, or documents);
